Hub/System/Components
System

Components.

The interface parts of the unifiedmeds website, live and in every state. Every specimen is built from components.css and the tokens in tokens.json. Hover, tap and tab through them.

Buttons Links & focus Form fields Cards, chips & steps Header & main menu Footer Overlay Feedback & states Interactive states Changes from Figma
Authority.

Decided rules and tokens win (R-01). The designer's Figma (website file h7D0eRszARBaWdJT1NWrpZ) is the source only for what is not decided yet, and our own Figma files are kept in sync with the rules. Every specimen here is built from components.css and the tokens. Every place the hub differs from a value in the designer's Figma is listed in Changes from Figma, so Figma can be updated.

Buttons.

Five types, one height, one shape, one motion. Source: Figma Buttons, Hover Rules 2676-309 (board 2719-4438) and the button rules R-40 and R-41.

Rounded rectangle, fixed padding.

Buttons are rounded rectangles with 5px corners (--radius-button), never pills: the capsule belongs to the logo (decision U-11). Height 50px (--size-control), side padding 24px (--size-button-padding-x), so width = label width + 48. The dashed lines mark the padding; the dashed box is the label. Source: Figma Button set 2676-310.

Contrast is label against fill (AA needs 4.5:1 for a 15px label). Figma’s Yellow hover is Pastel Blue #6E8B97 at 3.53:1; the hub uses Blue-dark (see Changes from Figma).

Side by side, never the same colour.

Current · R-112

Two buttons side by side never show the same colour, at rest or on hover, press or focus. An Outline, Outline Light or Light button next to a Yellow button hovers to Deep Teal with a Paper label, never to Yellow. A Dark button next to Yellow hovers to Blue-dark. On a Deep Teal surface the outline button hovers to Paper. components.css applies this to any two buttons that share a parent (:has(> .btn--yellow)); .btn-pair adds the row layout and stacks the pair full width on mobile.

Disabled Approved
Loading R-42

Disabled (R-42): the button keeps its own colours at 40% opacity (--opacity-disabled), no hover, no lift, cursor: not-allowed; always say why it is disabled nearby. Loading (R-42): same width and shape, the label hidden, the small capsule loader inside (40 wide, the same on mobile), not clickable; see Loading. The designer's Figma has no Disabled or Loading variant yet; both are on the Figma list.

Motion.

150ms ease-out.

Colour, border and lift share one transition: --motion-duration-fast with --motion-easing-ui. Press = hover = 150ms.

Lift 2px.

Every button rises --motion-distance-lift on hover and settles back on press. No shadow, no scale.

Reduced motion.

With prefers-reduced-motion the colour changes instantly and nothing lifts (brand.css sets both tokens to 0).

Desktop and mobile.

One spec on both.

Inter Medium 15/20, height 50, padding 24, radius 5, 1.5 border drawn inside, labels never wrap. Exceptions: Header 44 and the mobile bottom bar 48, full width. Tap target at least 44 (R-99).

Mobile has no hover.

A tap shows Pressed (hover colours, no lift) for 150ms, then the page reacts. Focus with a keyboard looks like hover plus the 2px ring, on every device.

Buttons with an icon.

A second family, never a replacement for the text buttons: same five types, colours, states and height. One 20px icon on the right of the label, in the label colour, 8px from it; padding 24 on the label side and 20 on the icon side. On hover the icon moves 2px in its direction, together with the lift; with reduced motion it stays still (R-100). Figma: our file, component set “Button / Icon”.

Do.

One icon per button, chosen by what the button does. Icon files: assets/icons/ui/ (stroke uses currentColor).

Don’t.

An icon instead of the label, two icons, an icon on the left, a Yellow icon, or the large capsule icons inside a button.

Labels and use.

Do.

Sentence case: “Get started”, “Explore treatments”, “Start your assessment”, “Learn more”. One primary action per view. One Yellow element per viewport. Full width only for E-03 and the footer CTA on mobile.

Don’t.

Title case (“Get Started”), a second size, a shadow, a Pastel Blue fill, Yellow text, a label that wraps, or a Back button in its own style (use Outline).

On the website, validate on blur, never on keystroke. The message says what to do. Errors use aria-invalid and aria-describedby.

The flow exception: the assessment checks on Continue.

Inside the assessment, answers are checked when he presses Continue, never on blur (Q95, pattern 2): the errors appear together, the first one takes focus, and Continue stays enabled. The field looks the same. See Assessment.

Answer options.

Current · R-42

One answer fills, several answers frame. A single choice is a choice card: selected, it fills Deep Teal with a Paper label and the Yellow mark (the one Yellow element in view). A multiple choice is a check card: selected, it keeps its Paper ground and takes a Deep Teal border plus a 1px inset, with the square box filled. Never a scale, never a shadow.

When is the best time for a provider to reach you?

Single choice · choice cards (.choice). Radius 16, padding 16 / 20, 8 apart.

Which of these apply to you?

Multiple choice · check cards (.option with .check). "None of these" clears the others.

Checkbox and radio.

Acknowledgements
Delivery

One spec, used on the website, the footer and the assessment (components.css .check): 22px, 1.5px Slate border (--color-line-field), radius 5 like buttons (R-30). The checkbox fills Deep Teal with a Paper tick; the radio is round with a Deep Teal dot. Invalid: 2px Coral border. Disabled: its own colours at 40%. The whole row is the hit area, at least 44px (--size-tap-min). Each acknowledgement is its own box, never pre-ticked. Mobile: the same size; rows stay 44 tall. Current

Progress is the capsule.

Desktop · 120 wide
Step 2 of 7 · Health history
Mobile · 96 wide
Step 2 of 7 · Health history

The progress mark is the logo capsule with its divider (R-42, R-109; O-09 closed): it fills from the long half, one step at a time, in 220ms ease-out (--motion-duration-open); reduced motion: instant. The fill sits inside the line and stops short of the divider, so a finished capsule keeps the gap. The text always names the step: "Step 2 of 7 · Health history". Desktop: 120 wide beside the label, with the step rail on the left of the assessment. Mobile: 96 wide above the question; tapping the label opens the full step list (Q102). The steps and their order live on Assessment. Line stroke 1.5 at every size (--size-capsule-stroke-min).

Cards, chips and steps.

UI is flat: borders, not shadows. Cards that are links fill Deep Teal on hover, with no lift. Cards in one row share one height; the action sits at the bottom of every card, on one line across the row, and captions sit on one line (R-98). In CSS: the row is a grid and each card uses grid-template-rows: subgrid.

Open.

☰ in a 44×44 button opens a full-screen menu that slides down in 220ms; the icon turns to ✕ and the page behind stops scrolling. Esc or ✕ closes it and returns focus to the button. Tab stays inside the menu while it is open.

Rows.

Category rows are 56px, Inter Medium 16/25. Sexual health expands in place (220ms) into a white card, radius 12, with rows of 48px or more. Only one category is open at a time. Tapping a product goes to its page and closes the menu.

Bottom bar.

Get started, Deep Teal, full width, 48px (E-03), then “Assessment only. Not a diagnosis.” in Body Fine Slate, above the device safe area.

The frame is 390 wide (--layout-frame-mobile) with the 64px mobile header (--size-header-mobile).

One choice card per option, the whole card is the target. Plans are 1, 3 and 6 months (Q100); the saving is a dollar amount per order, never a percentage (R-61); the 3 and 6 month plans carry the renewal slot "[renewal line · legal]"; no tablet counts in the title (use "[quantity · clinical]"). Figma draws radius 14; the card rule is 16 (R-43). A single choice fills, never scales (R-42); several answers use the check card under Answer options.

Segmented control and tabs.

Mist track, radius 12, 4px inset; the chosen option is Paper, Deep Teal label; the other is Slate. For two or three short options only.

Tabs switch views of one subject. Active: Deep Teal label and a 2px Deep Teal line under it; the line moves in 220ms. Never hide safety information behind a tab on a product page (R-66).

Tags.

Tadalafil, 20 mg tablets Recommended Combo No visit needed

Tags describe, they never act: Inter Regular 13, padding 6 / 14, fully round like the menu pill. Default Line/Base border; Highlight on Wash Yellow; Product: a dot in the product colour beside the name, the colour marks and never carries text or data (R-85, U-28); Quiet: a sentence-case label without a border (R-22). Strengths follow R-108 ("Tadalafil, 20 mg tablets"). On dark grounds the default tag takes a Wash Blue border and Paper text. Mobile: the same; tags wrap, never shrink.

Overlay surface, radius 12, the only other shadow. Bottom right on desktop, bottom centre on mobile, above the mobile bar. Success and info close after 5 seconds; an error stays until closed. Coral marks the error icon only, never the text (R-15). Never a toast for health results: results open their own page with the provider named.

Header and footer stay. Title in DM Serif Display at section size (the editorial moment of the page), no illustration of a broken object, no humour about health.

Loading.

Page loader: the one loader, the logo capsule with its divider (R-42, R-109; O-11 closed). It fills from the long half in 1.4s, the only loop on the site (R-53), shown after 400ms and never for less. The fill stops short of the divider, so a full capsule keeps the thin gap. 64 × 24.5px on desktop and on mobile; line 1.5px (--size-capsule-stroke-min, the R-109 stroke at this size). Geometry from tools/capsule_svg.py.

Button loading: same width, label hidden, the same loader at 40 × 15px inside, line still 1.5px; the same on mobile. The button is not clickable.

Skeleton: Mist blocks in the shape of the content. Static: no shimmer (only the loader loops).

Interactive states.

Toggles, two-state accents, steppers and the accordion, from Avi's review of the Sexual health landing page. Working demos, tokens only. Reduced motion makes every change instant and keeps the colours.

Toggle with a sliding thumb.

The thumb slides, the content cross-fades.

The Paper thumb slides to the chosen option in 220ms (--motion-duration-open, --motion-easing-ui). Content that depends on the choice, here the price and the picture, cross-fades in 180ms (--motion-duration-crossfade). Options at least 44 high including the track. Arrow keys move the choice.

Each state has its own accent.

First state Green, second state Blue.

Where a multi-state control marks data, each state has its own brand accent: the first Green, the second Blue. Here, as on the Sexual health landing page: Daily (first) Green, As needed (second) Blue. Never product colours, never Yellow (Yellow is the single result moment). The dots fill one after the other, 40ms apart (--motion-stagger-fine), never more than 180ms in total.

Stepper and scroll story.

Faded, active, passed.

Steps not reached sit at 45% (--opacity-step-faded). The active step gets a 2px Deep Teal border, a filled number and a short left accent bar. Passed steps return to full opacity with a small check. Each change takes 220ms. On a scroll story the active step follows the scroll; here Back and Next drive it, or tap a card.

Desktop: four cards in a row. Mobile: one column, number on the left, every card a full-width tap target. The copy is the one How it works wording (q132), the same as the step numbers above and the landing page.

Accordion.

One answer open at a time, height and opacity in 220ms, the chevron turns 180°. The live demo is the FAQ accordion under Cards, chips and steps; the footer columns on mobile use the same pattern.
